1|## Chapter 48 — The Long Winter
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents feared the cold that kills bodies. You fear the cold that kills trust."*  
     4|*Historian Amara Hale VIII: "We're not just enduring a season. We're testing what kind of cold we can survive."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a environmental pulse: Climate Anomaly Report - Extended Dust Storm Season Duration Exceeds Historical Maximums. Historian Amara Hale VIII adjusted her spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how climate actually shapes a civilization, as she looked at the notification flashing across her console in the Valles Marineris Historical Archives' environmental chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," she said, her voice carrying the rasp of years spent in climate studies and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this anomaly."
